I am a graduate student at Colorado State studying ecosystem science and sustainability. After graduating with a Bachelor of Arts in Environmental Studies, I continued my education to build on my technical skills and gain professional experience in environmental monitoring. I have experience with coding in R and ArcGIS and using these tools to address environmental concerns and devise solutions. Currently, I am focusing on water resource management, ultimately hoping to focus on water quality assessment. Upon completing my Professional Science Master’s degree, I am seeking a career in watershed management locally, in Larimer County.
